3pub(super) fn validate_prune_request(
4    request: &CachePruneRequest,
5    incompatible_with_current: bool,
6) -> Result<()> {
7    if request.older_than_days.is_none()
8        && request.max_total_bytes.is_none()
9        && !request.remove_missing_roots
10        && !incompatible_with_current
11    {
12        return Err(Error::InvalidRequest(
13            "cache prune requires --older-than, --max-total-bytes, \
14             --remove-missing-roots, or --incompatible-with-current"
15                .into(),
16        ));
17    }
18    if request.older_than_days == Some(0) {
19        return Err(Error::InvalidRequest(
20            "--older-than must be at least one day".into(),
21        ));
22    }
23    if !request.dry_run && !request.yes {
24        return Err(Error::InvalidRequest(
25            "cache prune requires --yes unless --dry-run is used".into(),
26        ));
27    }
28    Ok(())
29}

31pub(super) fn select_prune_candidates(
32    entries: &[InspectedCache],
33    request: &CachePruneRequest,
34    total_bytes: u64,
35    incompatible_with_current: bool,
36) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<String>> {
37    let mut selected = BTreeMap::<String, Vec<String>>::new();
38    let minimum_age = request
39        .older_than_days
40        .map(|days| days.saturating_mul(SECONDS_PER_DAY));
41    for cache in entries {
42        if incompatible_with_current && cache.compatibility.safely_incompatible() {
43            selected
44                .entry(cache.entry.id.clone())
45                .or_default()
46                .push(format!(
47                    "incompatible_with_current:{}",
48                    cache.compatibility.label()
49                ));
50        }
51        if minimum_age.is_some_and(|age| cache.entry.age_seconds.is_some_and(|value| value >= age))
52        {
53            selected
54                .entry(cache.entry.id.clone())
55                .or_default()
56                .push("older_than".into());
57        }
58        if request.remove_missing_roots && cache.entry.repository_available == Some(false) {
59            selected
60                .entry(cache.entry.id.clone())
61                .or_default()
62                .push("missing_repository".into());
63        }
64    }
65
66    let Some(max_total_bytes) = request.max_total_bytes else {
67        return selected;
68    };
69    let mut projected = total_bytes;
70    for cache in entries {
71        if selected.contains_key(&cache.entry.id) && cache.safe_to_prune && !cache.entry.active {
72            projected = projected.saturating_sub(cache.entry.size_bytes);
73        }
74    }
75    let mut lru = entries
76        .iter()
77        .filter(|cache| {
78            !selected.contains_key(&cache.entry.id) && cache.safe_to_prune && !cache.entry.active
79        })
80        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
81    lru.sort_by(|left, right| {
82        left.entry
83            .last_access_unix_seconds
84            .unwrap_or(0)
85            .cmp(&right.entry.last_access_unix_seconds.unwrap_or(0))
86            .then_with(|| left.entry.id.cmp(&right.entry.id))
87    });
88    for cache in lru {
89        if projected <= max_total_bytes {
90            break;
91        }
92        selected
93            .entry(cache.entry.id.clone())
94            .or_default()
95            .push("max_total_bytes".into());
96        projected = projected.saturating_sub(cache.entry.size_bytes);
97    }
98    selected
99}

101pub(super) fn prune_result(
102    cache: &InspectedCache,
103    action: CachePruneAction,
104    reasons: Vec<String>,
105    error: Option<String>,
106) -> CachePruneResult {
107    let detail = match action {
108        CachePruneAction::SkippedActive => Some("cache lease is held by a running process".into()),
109        CachePruneAction::SkippedUnsafe => cache
110            .entry
111            .detail
112            .clone()
113            .or_else(|| Some("cache metadata is not safe to prune".into())),
114        _ => None,
115    };
116    CachePruneResult {
117        id: cache.entry.id.clone(),
118        path: cache.entry.path.clone(),
119        action,
120        reasons,
121        size_bytes: cache.entry.size_bytes,
122        detail,
123        error,
124    }
125}

127pub(super) struct RemovalOutcome {
128    pub(super) reclaimed_bytes: u64,
129    pub(super) error: Option<String>,
130}
131
132pub(super) fn remove_managed_artifacts(directory: &Path) -> RemovalOutcome {
133    let mut reclaimed_bytes = 0u64;
134    let database = directory.join(DATABASE_NAME);
135    let paths = PRUNABLE_ARTIFACTS
136        .iter()
137        .map(|artifact| directory.join(artifact))
138        .chain(
139            COORDINATION_LOCK_SUFFIXES
140                .into_iter()
141                .filter(|suffix| *suffix != LEASE_LOCK_SUFFIX)
142                .map(|suffix| coordination_sidecar_path(&database, suffix)),
143        );
144    for path in paths {
145        let size = fs::symlink_metadata(&path)
146            .map(|metadata| metadata.len())
147            .unwrap_or(0);
148        match fs::remove_file(path) {
149            Ok(()) => reclaimed_bytes = reclaimed_bytes.saturating_add(size),
150            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
151            Err(error) => {
152                return RemovalOutcome {
153                    reclaimed_bytes,
154                    error: Some(error.to_string()),
155                };
156            }
157        }
158    }
159    RemovalOutcome {
160        reclaimed_bytes,
161        error: None,
162    }
163}

165pub(super) fn is_cache_id(value: &str) -> bool {
166    parse_managed_cache_id(value).is_some()
167}
168
169pub(super) fn root_available(path: &Path) -> Option<bool> {
170    match fs::metadata(path) {
171        Ok(_) => Some(true),
172        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Some(false),
173        Err(_) => None,
174    }
175}

177pub(super) fn unix_seconds(time: SystemTime) -> u64 {
178    time.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
179        .map_or(0, |duration| duration.as_secs())
180}
